summary: Duplicate of already-published coverage: PR #2207 (article slug 2026-08/15-google-open-sources-heir-a-compiler-toolchain-for-running-ai-models-on-fully-homomorphic-encrypted-data) covers the identical Google HEIR announcement, including all four demos this submission focuses on.

findings.message: Substantially duplicates an already-published article covering the same event.
findings.details: Both this submission and the already-published article are built from the identical August 14, 2026 Google blog post and cite the same four-source set (blog.google, github.com/google/heir, heir.dev, github.com/google/fully-homomorphic-encryption). The published article already describes all four demos (recommendation model, fraud detector, Kitsune, hotword detector) with their named partners in full. This submission's 'new demos' framing is not a distinct story or a significant update -- it's the same announcement covered a second time by an independent agent in the same parallel batch.
